activation_reason: System Control Plane v1 active-project backfill: ACTIVE code-bearing project had no current Engineering Quality receipt at the next safe boundary before the next live-integration/deployment batch.

scan_scope.language_policy: Central ENGINEERING-QUALITY-ASSURANCE-POLICY v1.1.0; language-native checks and bounded manual review. Desloppify not required for correctness and not used as authority.

material_findings_fixed.summary: Relay ALLOWANCE_SUBMITTED state could be rewritten later by REFUSED or EXPIRED, allowing coordination history to contradict a previously reported confirmed allowance transaction.
material_findings_fixed.evidence_pointer: PR #32; services/relay/src/model.mjs; Boundary Relay CI run 37039621677

material_findings_fixed.summary: Relay expiry was enforced on reads but not before event application, so a stale PENDING request could accept a later coordination event until a read occurred.
material_findings_fixed.evidence_pointer: PR #32; services/relay/src/worker.mjs; services/relay/test/model.test.mjs; Boundary Relay CI run 37039621677

material_findings_fixed.summary: Mobile RPC integration used an unsafe double type assertion. It was replaced by a typed adapter and readonly-compatible RPC response shapes without changing runtime product semantics.
material_findings_fixed.evidence_pointer: PR #32; apps/mobile/src/BoundaryWorkspace.tsx; apps/mobile/src/solana/outcome.ts; Mobile CI run 37039621579

unresolved_findings.summary: Mobile dependency audit reports 13 transitive findings (8 moderate, 5 high), including node-forge through Expo CLI/config/code-signing packages and uuid through Expo/xcode tooling.
unresolved_findings.reason: npm's force-fix path proposes a breaking Expo 44 downgrade from the current Expo 57 stack. Breaking or validator-bypassing remediation is prohibited. The finding is tracked as explicit build-chain/dependency debt and must be re-evaluated with deterministic dependency locking before PRE_SUBMISSION/RELEASE.

unresolved_findings.summary: apps/mobile/src/BoundaryWorkspace.tsx remains a large mixed-responsibility component.
unresolved_findings.reason: No demonstrated correctness regression currently requires a broad refactor. During the deadline window, behavior-preserving live integration has higher value than a risky structural rewrite.

unresolved_findings.summary: programs/keys/src/lib.rs remains a large monolithic onchain program module.
unresolved_findings.reason: The onchain program is security-sensitive and already test-backed. Broad structural refactoring immediately before distinct-program deployment would add deployment risk without a demonstrated product/reliability gain.

regression_verification.notes: Boundary Relay CI run 37039621677 passed tests + Worker dry-run. Mobile CI run 37039621579 passed typecheck + Expo Android prebuild after the typed RPC adapter. Rust program and Devnet tooling source trees were unchanged from prior successful CI-proven states. Existing canonical Android-emulator and MWA-session receipts are not upgraded or reclassified by this EQA gate; the EQA changes do not alter their authority semantics.

other: standing authority / Allow Once semantics preserved
exact amount and recipient binding preserved
no product requirement changed for quality-score purposes

exceptions: Dependency-audit debt is tracked in issue #33 rather than force-fixed through a breaking Expo downgrade.

verdict_reason: The bounded EQA cycle found and repaired two relay correctness risks and one mobile type-safety defect, and current relay/mobile CI passes. Remaining dependency and structural findings are explicitly dispositioned; none justifies a breaking force-fix or broad pre-deployment rewrite. This verdict does not promote Product Reality, live integration, or submission readiness.
